step0.title: Welcome to Klarwert
step0.description: 100% local – your financial data stays on this device. No login, no cloud.
step0.exploreDemoTooltip: Creates a sample household with several months of example transactions, accounts, a budget, and a collection – a great way to try Klarwert risk-free. Reversible any time via "Delete all data" in Profile.

step1.title: Who are you?
step1.description: People are only used for assignment; there are no access rights.

step2.title: Create your first account
step2.description: For Klarwert to show your finances, you need at least one account or asset.
